Test data of package sigv4

OUR OWN FILES (this directory, not third-party)
  SOURCES.txt, third_party.sha256, fetch-third-party.sh.
  The four examples of the Amazon S3 documentation in sigv4_test.go are
  written into the test itself ("Signature Calculations for the Authorization
  Header: Transferring Payload in a Single Chunk (AWS Signature Version 4)",
  with the example credentials of that page).

THIRD-PARTY FILES (third_party/, not committed with our own files)
  third_party/aws-sig-v4-test-suite/: the "AWS Signature Version 4 test suite"
  (files .req, .creq, .sts, .authz, .sreq per case, with its LICENSE and NOTICE),
  as kept in the botocore project, directory tests/unit/auth/aws4_testsuite of
  https://github.com/boto/botocore, at commit
  32302bc372dde1b6173b60f8b85d671e24a0d414 (the last commit that touched that
  directory; the files equal those of the develop branch head when they were
  checked). Licence: Apache-2.0 (the LICENSE and NOTICE files travel with the
  data). Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.
  Credentials of the suite: AKIDEXAMPLE / wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG+bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY,
  region us-east-1, service "service", date 20150830T123600Z. Upstream keeps ten
  cases in the groups normalize-path and post-sts-token; here they sit flat.

  The directory is test data only: it is read by tests at run time, never
  embedded, never part of a binary. It is fetched by fetch-third-party.sh and
  checked against third_party.sha256 (a file with another sum, or a file that is
  not listed, fails TestThirdPartyManifest). When the directory is absent the
  tests that need it skip with a message naming it, and all others run.

Vectors of our own (not in this directory)
  own_vectors_test.go holds nine requests with their canonical request, string
  to sign and Authorization header, produced once by an independent
  implementation of the algorithm (written from the AWS documentation, sharing
  no code with this package). The signature of the "vanilla" request is the one
  that the AWS suite documents for get-vanilla. They are part of the test binary.
